Ben —

Quick notes from legal after an initial pass (see attached Legal-QA-Summary.docx for straight redlines/comments):

1) Tax passthrough / indemnity (Clause 5.1): we should avoid a one-way indemnity that makes Redwood liable for marketplace-imposed taxes when CloudCart collects and remits those taxes. Proposed compromise:
   - Redwood accepts a representation that CloudCart will collect and remit applicable taxes to authorities.
   - CloudCart must provide timely notice of any tax assessments and cooperate in contesting them.
   - Instead of full indemnity, add a limited passthrough for taxes directly levied on Redwood usage where Redwood is the legal taxpayer (i.e., where Redwood has legal liability), but not for taxes that arise solely because CloudCart billed an extra surcharge.

2) Invoice waterfall (Attachment B): the sequencing looks standard, but we need to confirm invoice signature/PO flow. If CloudCart will act as the seller of record in the marketplace, invoices should be issued to the end-customer by CloudCart; Redwood's invoice to CloudCart should be net of CloudCart's platform fee. Ops — confirm that we can accept net invoicing and process credits against gross USD amounts.

3) Audit and records (Clause 8): add a 2-year audit right limited to the marketplace fees and reconciliation items, with confidentiality and cost-shifting for frivolous audits.

4) Data residency and logs: require monthly reporting of aggregated usage and a monthly remittance statement in CSV so finance can reconcile.

If acceptable, I'll prepare a redline that converts current CloudCart indemnity into the limited passthrough language above and add the audit right. If we want to be more seller-friendly (i.e., CloudCart bears more risk), we can ask for escrow or reserve on disputed tax amounts.

I can turn this into a full redline by EOD. Let me know preferences on whether we want to: (A) accept limited passthrough + audit right, or (B) insist on escrow/reserve for disputed tax amounts.

-Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Ben / Kim — operations input below: 

- Billing: We can support net invoicing to CloudCart provided they supply a standard monthly remittance file (CSV) per Kim's note. Our AR system requires: invoice number mapping, gross amount, platform fee, reseller fee, tax line. The proposed spreadsheet covers these columns; minor formatting tweaks needed.
- Rev recognition: Finance needs to treat CloudCart as a principal vs agent depending on who is the seller of record; that will affect revenue timing. We need legal to confirm the seller-of-record language.
- Payments: prefer 30 days net; we can accept monthly cycles. ACH details will be needed from CloudCart.
- Implementation: we'll need ~3 sprints of engineering to ingest the remittance CSV automatically unless CloudCart agrees to our CSV template. For now manual reconciliation ok for Q1.

Recommendation: go with Kimberly's option (limited passthrough + monthly remittance + 2-year audit right). Ask CloudCart to follow our CSV template and provide ACH/PO requirements.

-Marissa Cole

2) Ops/Finance (Marissa) can support net invoicing with a monthly remittance CSV. We will provide a template and expect CloudCart to populate it. Payments on a 30-day net cadence.
3) Implementation: For Q1 we agree to manual reconciliation while engineering scopes a 3-sprint integration to ingest remittance files automatically.
